exposure: Length of hospital stay after birth (>2 days)
outcome: Readmission for hyperbilirubinemia reaching phototherapy level
cohort: The study included 51 consecutive neonates >35 weeks gestational age readmitted to the hospital for jaundice, compared to 164 controls.
finding: The risk of readmission for hyperbilirubinemia was lower among infants receiving mixed/formula feeding, those fed >8 times per day, and those who stayed in the hospital for more than 2 days after birth.
